2645-3430-3478-4644.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-3478-4644.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2438-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2438-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-4506-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4506-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1052-3175-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3532-4668-5078-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4668-5078-7328.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3532-4668-5078-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2463-3259-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2463-3259-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1692-6705-7150.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Resolve the copy of the Helm of the Host trigger, creating a token copy of Kirol that isn't legendary and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
Holding priority, activate the Kirol token by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

997-5170-6132-6273.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2034-4871-6476-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2034-4871-6476-6991.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Donnie & April and at least two other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three of the creatures returned in step 1, adding six {C}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers three times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

147-3440-4050.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2146-2363-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Cloud Key, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2866-4211-4659-4986.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2854-3200-4574-6918.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-3200-4574-6918.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

851-1563-4321-5777.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

147-3967-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-3967-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1020-1117-4659-5705.notablePrerequisites:
One of the artifact creatures must be in your hand while the other is in your graveyard.
You have enough mana to cast the artifact card in your hand.
1020-1117-4659-5705.description:
Cast the artifact creature card in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the artifact creature spell, triggering Glaring Fleshraker's second ability, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact creature dies, it triggers, returning the other artifact creature from your graveyard to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

618-3525-6252.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Boommobile with haste.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
618-3525-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target other creature(s) using Kiki-Jiki's ability or activate a Boommobile's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2060-3129-3490-3910-4017.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
2060-3129-3490-3910-4017.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting ten +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

1445-3480-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-3480-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

575-897-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Branchsnap Lorian, adding one mana of any color.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2366-2882-4050-4552.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Blossoming Tortoise.
2366-2882-4050-4552.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield as a copy of Blossoming Tortoise due to Infinite Reflection, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Dryad Arbor trigger from step 2, causing you to mill three cards and return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

254-1657-2292.description:
Cast First Day of School, causing it so that each creature that enters the battlefield under your control this turn gets a +1/+1 counter put on it and gains haste until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer, sacrificing Murderous Redcap to scry one.
Murderous Redcap's persist triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
First Day of School triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Murderous Redcap.
Murderous Redcap triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

799-1164-5131.description:
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying {4}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it, choosing Karn's Temporal Sundering from exile and putting it on the top of your library.
Cast Mirror of Fate from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

813-2665-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Scholar of the Ages.
813-2665-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
When the token Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Warp and up to one additional target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

824-2464-2760.notablePrerequisites:
Song of Freyalise has one or two lore counters.
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
A creature you control has a -1/-1 counter on it.
824-2464-2760.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a -1/-1 counter from a creature you control to any other creature you control.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat.
